rationale: This round's blocker fix: a committed nomination may no longer nominate ITSELF. Disabling that one branch in validateClaim lets a self-nomination through against a colluding diff, which reddens the self-nomination case in the reader suite (verified: 24 pass / 1 fail mutated, 25 pass / 0 fail restored); mutation-prover.test.ts never nominates that path and stays green (73 pass / 0 fail under the same mutation).
